title: Dr. Carvalho's 35 Colares patients, interviewed by Jacques Vallee

tellings.quote: spoke to Dr. Carvalo who saw 35 patients who all had the same sunburns and puncture wounds and the two women that died of a stroke

plain: In 1977, in the Brazilian town of Colares, a local doctor named Carvalho is said to have treated 35 patients who all had the same sunburns and puncture wounds, and two women among them died of strokes. Michels tells this from Forbidden Science, the published journals of the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée, who went to Colares and spoke with the doctor. If true, it would mean that something in the sky was physically harming people there.
